sections.title: Transformation Masks
sections.note: The Moon Children don't take these, and the Fierce Deity's Mask only works in boss rooms.

items.name: Deku Mask
items.howTo: In the first cycle, take the Ocarina back from the Skull Kid on top of the Clock Tower at midnight on the Final Day and play the Song of Time. Back on Day 1, the Happy Mask Salesman teaches you the Song of Healing, which lifts the curse and leaves the Deku Mask.
items.reward: Deku form: Deku flowers, bubbles, skipping on water
items.notes: Happens as part of the story; it can't be missed.

items.name: Goron Mask
items.howTo: Use the Lens of Truth in Mountain Village to see Darmani's ghost and follow him to the Goron Graveyard. Play the Song of Healing for him at his grave.
items.reward: Goron form: rolling, pounding, the Goron drums

items.name: Zora Mask
items.howTo: Push the dying Mikau out of the sea to the shore of Great Bay Coast and play the Song of Healing for him.
items.reward: Zora form: swimming, boomerang fins, the Zora guitar

items.name: Fierce Deity's Mask
items.area: The field under the tree, inside the Moon
items.howTo: Inside the Moon, give the four Moon Children in Odolwa's, Goht's, Gyorg's and Twinmold's masks all 20 of your other masks: each takes some to open their trial and more at its end. Then talk to the child in Majora's Mask under the tree.
items.after: All four Remains, Night of the Final Day
items.reward: Fierce Deity form, usable only in boss rooms
items.notes: You keep the masks you hand over. The four trials also hold the Moon's four Pieces of Heart.

sections.title: Masks
sections.note: The 20 the Moon Children ask for. Masks are kept through the Song of Time, but most need every step done in one cycle.

items.name: Great Fairy's Mask
items.howTo: Catch the Clock Town Stray Fairy (Laundry Pool by day, East Clock Town at night) and bring it to the Fairy's Fountain in North Clock Town as human Link. The first visit, as a Deku in the first cycle, gives magic instead; bring the fairy back in human form for the mask.
items.reward: The mask's hair shimmers near Stray Fairies, and it draws them to you in temples

items.name: Bremen Mask
items.howTo: On Night 1 or Night 2 (6 p.m.–6 a.m.), talk to Guru-Guru at the Laundry Pool in human form and listen to his story.
items.reward: Plays a march that baby animals follow

items.name: Kafei's Mask
items.howTo: On Day 1 or Day 2 (10 a.m.–8 p.m.), talk to Madame Aroma in the Mayor's Residence and agree to look for her son.
items.reward: Lets you ask around about Kafei; starts the Anju and Kafei quest

items.name: Blast Mask
items.howTo: At midnight on Night 1, Sakon snatches the Old Lady's bag as she walks through North Clock Town. Hit him with your sword (or shoot him) before he gets away. She gives you the mask.
items.reward: Explodes like a bomb on your face, costing a little health
items.notes: Saving her also lets the Bomb Shop sell the Big Bomb Bag and the Curiosity Shop sell the All-Night Mask later in the same cycle.

items.name: All-Night Mask
items.howTo: On the Night of the Final Day (from 10 p.m.), buy it at the Curiosity Shop for 500 Rupees. It's only for sale if you stopped Sakon robbing the Old Lady on Night 1 of the same cycle.
items.reward: Keeps you awake through Anju's Grandmother's stories

items.name: Keaton Mask
items.area: Curiosity Shop back room, via the Laundry Pool
items.howTo: In the Anju and Kafei quest: once Kafei has given you the Pendant of Memories for Anju (Day 2), go to the back room of the Curiosity Shop on the Final Day. The shop owner gives you the Keaton Mask and the Special Delivery to Mama.
items.reward: Summons Keaton from the dancing bushes for his quiz
items.notes: Zelda Wiki has the back room unlocking at 1 p.m. on the Final Day.

items.name: Postman's Hat
items.area: Post Office, then by the Milk Bar
items.howTo: On the Final Day, give the Special Delivery to Mama (from the Curiosity Shop owner, see the Keaton Mask) to the Postman instead of to Madame Aroma. He runs off to deliver it; meet him by the Milk Bar and he gives you his hat as he flees town.
items.reward: Lets you look inside postboxes; one of them holds a Piece of Heart
items.notes: The same letter given to Madame Aroma gets a Bottle of Chateau Romani instead, so do it in two cycles.

items.name: Couple's Mask
items.howTo: Finish the Anju and Kafei quest in one cycle: Kafei's Mask (Day 1), Anju's Letter to Kafei (Night 1, 11:30 p.m. in the inn kitchen), the Pendant of Memories (Day 2, Laundry Pool), the Sun's Mask taken back from Sakon's Hideout in Ikana Canyon (Final Day, from 6 p.m.). Then wait in the inn's staff room for Kafei on the Night of the Final Day; they marry just before dawn (about 4:30 a.m.) and give you the mask.
items.reward: Ends arguments; the Mayor gives a Piece of Heart for it

items.name: Kamaro's Mask
items.area: North Termina Field, on a mushroom-shaped rock
items.howTo: After midnight on any night (12 a.m.–6 a.m.), find Kamaro dancing on a rock in north Termina Field and play the Song of Healing for him.
items.reward: Kamaro's dance; the Rosa Sisters give a Piece of Heart for it

items.name: Bunny Hood
items.howTo: From 6 a.m. to 8 p.m. on any day, wear the Bremen Mask in the Cucco Shack and march until all ten chicks follow you. They grow into Cuccos and Grog gives you the hood.
items.after: Powder Keg, to blow up the boulder on Milk Road
items.reward: Run faster and jump further; the Postman's timer stays on screen

items.name: Romani's Mask
items.howTo: Help Romani fight off the ghosts at the barn on Night 1 (2:30–5:15 a.m.). On Day 2 talk to Cremia in the barn, then meet her at 6 p.m. and guard her milk cart on the road through Gorman Track by shooting the Gorman Brothers. She gives you the mask.
items.after: Powder Keg, and Epona and the Hero's Bow
items.reward: Lets you into the Milk Bar at night

items.name: Circus Leader's Mask
items.howTo: On Night 1 or Night 2 (10 p.m.–5 a.m.), wear Romani's Mask into the Milk Bar and talk to Toto on the stage. Play his sound check as human Link, then as a Deku, a Goron and a Zora. The full Ballad of the Wind Fish moves Gorman to tears and he gives you his mask.
items.reward: Calms the Gorman Brothers on the milk run
items.notes: Called the Troupe Leader's Mask in Majora's Mask 3D.

items.name: Garo's Mask
items.howTo: From 6 a.m. to 6 p.m. on any day, ride Epona into Gorman Track, pay the Gorman Brothers 10 Rupees and beat them in the horse race.
items.after: Epona's Song and the Powder Keg
items.reward: Fools the Ikana guard; summons Garo ninjas in Ikana Canyon

items.name: Mask of Scents
items.howTo: After Woodfall Temple, carry the Deku Princess in a Bottle back to the Deku King in the same cycle. The Deku Butler then waits in the Deku Shrine (reached by water west of the palace); keep up with him in his race as a Deku to get the mask.
items.reward: Sniffs out Magic Mushrooms for the Potion Shop

items.name: Mask of Truth
items.howTo: Collect all 30 Gold Skulltula tokens in the Swamp Spider House in one cycle. The cursed man at the entrance gives you the mask.
items.reward: Read the minds of animals and Gossip Stones
items.notes: Every token is listed in the Spider Houses tracker.

items.name: Don Gero's Mask
items.howTo: In the Goron Shrine, play the Goron Lullaby to put the Elder's son to sleep and light every torch with a Deku Stick so the chandelier spins. Goron-roll into the chandelier until the Rock Sirloin drops out, carry it to Mountain Village and throw it to the starving Goron on the ledge.
items.after: Goron Lullaby, before Snowhead Temple (while it's winter)
items.reward: Lets you talk to frogs and gather the Frog Choir

items.name: Stone Mask
items.area: Road to Ikana, in a circle of stones
items.howTo: Use the Lens of Truth in the circle of stones on the Road to Ikana to see Shiro, the forgotten soldier. Give him a Red or Blue Potion.
items.after: Lens of Truth and a Bottle of potion
items.reward: Most enemies and people stop noticing you
items.notes: Majora's Mask 3D moves Shiro into the Pirates' Fortress.

items.name: Captain's Hat
items.howTo: At night in Ikana Graveyard, play the Sonata of Awakening at the big skull by the entrance to wake Captain Keeta. Chase him to the end of his path and beat him; he leaves the hat in a chest.
items.after: Garo's or Gibdo Mask to get into Ikana Canyon
items.reward: Command the Stalchildren; open the night graves

items.name: Gibdo Mask
items.howTo: Play the Song of Storms for Sharp in the Spring Water Cave so the river and the music box run again. When Pamela steps out of the Music Box House, slip inside, go down to the basement and play the Song of Healing for her father.
items.after: Ice Arrows and the Song of Storms
items.reward: Gibdos and ReDeads leave you alone; get past the Ikana guard

items.name: Giant's Mask
items.howTo: In the inverted Stone Tower Temple, beat the Eyegore guarding the chest that holds the mask.
items.reward: Grow to giant size, only in Twinmold's arena
items.notes: In Majora's Mask 3D the mask is dropped by the first Twinmold instead.
